user.title: Connect to BookClub
user.description: Enter the address of your BookClub server and the API token from BookClub's Settings → Home Assistant.

data_description.api_token: Shown in BookClub under Settings → Home Assistant.

reauth_confirm.title: BookClub API token
reauth_confirm.description: BookClub at {url} refused the API token. Copy the current one from BookClub's Settings → Home Assistant.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach BookClub at that address.

abort.already_configured: This BookClub server is already set up.

data_description.send_events: BookClub posts every event (book imported, request needs a choice, ...) to Home Assistant, fired as bookclub_event.
data_description.install_sentences: Writes custom_sentences/en/bookclub.yaml so Assist understands "download the audiobook ..." and "what is BookClub doing". A file you wrote yourself is never overwritten.

request_book.name: Request a book
request_book.description: Asks BookClub to find an audiobook on the forum and download it.

config_entry_id.name: BookClub server
config_entry_id.description: Only needed when more than one BookClub server is set up.

query.name: Book
query.description: The book title, optionally followed by "by" and the author, e.g. Project Hail Mary by Andy Weir.

requested_by.name: Requested by
requested_by.description: Who asked (shown in BookClub and sent back with its events). Defaults to the Home Assistant user.

force.name: Even if already in the library
force.description: Download it even when BookClub thinks the library already has it.

choose_option.name: Choose a request option
choose_option.description: Picks one of the books a request offered (request_needs_choice).

config_entry_id.name: BookClub server
config_entry_id.description: Only needed when more than one BookClub server is set up.

request_id.name: Request ID
request_id.description: request_id from the event or from Request a book.

option.name: Option
option.description: The option number from the event's options list.

cancel_request.name: Cancel a request
cancel_request.description: Stops a request that has not been sent to the downloader yet.

config_entry_id.name: BookClub server
config_entry_id.description: Only needed when more than one BookClub server is set up.

add_to_wishlist.name: Add to wishlist
add_to_wishlist.description: Has BookClub watch the forum for a book, an author or a series.

config_entry_id.name: BookClub server
config_entry_id.description: Only needed when more than one BookClub server is set up.

query.name: What to watch for
query.description: A book title, an author or a series name.

author.name: Author
author.description: Narrows a book or series down to this author.

auto_download.name: Download automatically
auto_download.description: Download as soon as it appears, instead of only notifying.

requested_by.name: Requested by
requested_by.description: Who asked. Defaults to the Home Assistant user.
